serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-agent-graph-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that builds a reachability graph across multi-agent orchestration configs (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/ag2) to find transitive excessive agency — an agent with no dangerous tool of its own that can still reach one through delegation or group membership

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan a Python snippet defining a multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen/ag2) for excessive agency reachable through delegation or group membership.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single Python file for excessive-agency paths across LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen orchestration constructs

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the .py file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of Python files, building one merged agent/tool graph across all of them, and report excessive-agency paths.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 2000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every dangerous-capability rule this auditor looks for at the end of a delegation path, grouped by category
